corrections.reason: The printed glyph at the end of Line 3 has the top-right vowel ring of 7th-order ኖ (forming ድኖዋል across the line wrap), which was misread as 6th-order ን.
Canonical Ge'ez Luke 15:12 vocative 'አባ ሀበኒ መክፈልተ ርስትየ' ('Father, give me the portion of my inheritance'); the printed glyph is 1st-order አ, not 6th-order እ.
Restored the missing closing quote marker ⟫ after the Ge'ez root citation 'ወበህየ ዘረወ ፡' before the Amharic commentary 'በአምልኮተ ጣዖት...'.
In Luke 15:14 the Ge'ez verb is singular 'ወተፅነሰ' ('and he began to be in want'); the printed glyph is 1st-order ሰ followed by ፡, which ink bleed caused to be misread as ሡ.
The multi-stemmed character ዢ in 'ተገዢ ሆኑ' ('they became subject/servants to one of the citizens') was split and misread by OCR as ጋቮ.
Canonical Ge'ez Luke 15:16 reads 'ወፈተወ ይፅገብ' ('and he desired to be filled'); the printed crossbar of ተ is clearly visible and was misread as ነ.
In the Ge'ez citation of Luke 15:22 ('አልብሶ ቀድመ'), the final character has the double loop of መ ('quickly/first'), which was misread as ወ.

corrections.old_text: ፍ፡ ኀበ ብእሲ ኃጥእ ቦአ የዓል
corrections.corrected_text: ፍ፡ ኀበ ብእሲ ኃጥእ ቦአ ይዕል
corrections.reason: This is the Ge'ez cross-reference to Luke 19:7 ('ኀበ ብእሲ ኃጥእ ቦአ ይዕል' — 'he has gone in to lodge with a sinful man'); the printed glyphs at the end of the line are ይዕል, misread as የዓል.
